messages.subject: Stan-citing paper to add to the list
parts:
This is the paper resulting from all the bugging I did on the list regarding a circular mixture model. Thanks again all for your help!

@Article{Fawcett2016,
  author = {Jonathan M. Fawcett and Michael A. Lawrence and Tracy L. Taylor},
  title = {The representational consequences of intentional forgetting: 
     {Impairments} to both the probability and fidelity of long-term memory.},
  journal = {Journal Of Experimental Psychology: General},
  volume = {145},
  number = {1},
  pages = {56-81},
  year = {2016},
  doi = {10.1037/xge0000128},
  url={http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4694085/},
}
